description: This file is a shell script that contains test routines for a word diff coloring tool, including setup, various test cases, and utility functions for diff display testing.

methods.name: word_diff
methods.description: Performs a word-based diff between two files identified by Git hashes, with color decoding and comparison against expected output.

methods.name: test_language_driver
methods.description: Sets up and runs tests for different language diff drivers, validating their correct behavior.
